summary_1line: Bhishma teaches that a king must uphold social duties and support Brahmanas; a righteous Kaikeya king’s virtue protects him from a Rakshasa.

image_candidates.scene_text: A Rakshasa seizes the ascetic king of the Kaikeyas in a forest as the king calmly declares the righteousness of his realm.
The battle-scarred king stands proudly before the demon, listing the virtues and duties faithfully practiced by every class in his kingdom.
The Rakshasa releases the king in the forest, acknowledging the power of a ruler who protects Brahmanas, cows, and his people.
